title: runners-config.md still documents tk cloud spawn/wait/collect, which no longer exist
description:
internal/runconfig/runners-config.md (the cloud substrate section, ~lines 626-652) tells a local orchestrator to dispatch cloud workers with `tk cloud spawn/wait/collect/reconcile`; ticks deleted those verbs in chz and ticfac has no equivalent verbs. The section should describe ticfac's cloud dispatch instead.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding 8dec6cf23d0af8c3a6655b2a55f95bdad1b8eb2d17809861fccdd05d1bcb6ad4 (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-46x/attempt-4): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/8dec6cf23d0af8c3a6655b2a55f95bdad1b8eb2d17809861fccdd05d1bcb6ad4.json on the run branch.
